field_changes.after: Council approved permanent EESS regulations 6-0 on October 13, 2026. Ordinance 1763 terminated the Ordinance 1754 moratorium upon its immediate effectiveness. It prohibits stationary utility-scale EESS in all zoning districts and sets standards and restrictions for other EESS, including limited emergency use of mobile utility-scale EESS.
